topic.title: Clarifications on 12h overrun, ParallelAgent concurrency, LoRA loading, and self-generated training data

comments.content:
• 12h overrun: Not yet. Budget per task using eval_config.yaml.
  • Parallel: I we don't support parallel calls.
  • LoRA: I applied a fix for LoRA loading yesterday. You can see the limits on rank and size in the getting started notebook and also in the HARNESS_README.md. There's also a total submission limit of 3GB.
  • Training data: Training on gemma-4-31b itself is fine. We'll try to have an answer for outputs from other models soon.

Hi @ryanholbrook , thanks for the earlier answers. Two follow-up questions about the agent schema:

Callbacks: SandboxedLlmAgentConfig accepts before_model_callbacks, after_model_callbacks, before_tool_callbacks and after_tool_callbacks (resolved by name from CallbackRegistry), but the registry seems to be empty in adk-submission 0.2.11. Are any callbacks registered in the scoring environment, or planned? For example, a pre-approved callback that stops an agent after N identical consecutive tool calls, or one that restarts the agent with a fresh context. In our traces, the most common failure of gemma-4-31b is repeating the same tool call many times until the time budget runs out. Forcing tool calls: a model reply without a function call ends an LlmAgent. Is there a supported way to require a tool call on every turn (like tool_config / function-calling mode ANY in ADK), or is that intentionally not exposed?

I'm very curious whether the Notebook Timeout is caused by exceeding the upper limit of the inference budget. In other words, could this potentially be resolved by reducing the inference budget for each individual task?
